notes: Facts from FIXED.DAT/NONFIXED.DAT, NPCDATA and EUSECODE.FLX v2.10. See specs/world/leveling_facts.md section 3 for the rules behind every number.

eggs = placed monster eggs (shape 500) of that monster type. hatchable = eggs that have at least one MONEGG or MONFAST hatcher with a matching id within 3584 units. orphan = the rest; they never spawn.
links_monegg and links_monfast count (hatcher, egg) pairs. An egg with two hatchers spawns twice per cycle, so links can exceed eggs.
one_shot = eggs with frame != 0. MONEGG destroys such an egg after hatching it; MONFAST does not. one_shot_true = those reached only through MONEGG, which therefore spawn once per save.
Every hatch repeats whenever the hatcher re-arms (its chunk leaves the fast area); see the spec. Counts are per pass through the map, not lifetime limits.
Whether every hatcher is physically reachable by the Avatar was not checked.
category is a convenience: human = guards, townsfolk, sorcerers, theurgists; vermin = small spider, small lizard. Monster table values are copied from specs/world/combat.md 6.
